simulator.title: Run a tournament in two minutes
simulator.subtitle: Everything below is a simulation with sample data. Set up a tournament, pick a theme, turn on overlays and play a match. This is the same overlay engine that runs on air.

tournament.title: Tournament
tournament.hint: Name your event and set its colours. The overlay changes as you type.

round.title: Round
round.hint: A round holds the matches of one stage, like the Grand Finals.

teams.title: Groups & teams
teams.hint: Teams and players are already set up for you. In the real app you add them once and reuse them.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Every theme covers the same overlays. Pick a look.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.hint: Each tile is one OBS Browser Source. Click one to put it on air.

live.title: Go live
live.hint: Play the match: kills, knocks and eliminations reach every overlay instantly.

desktopTools.label: Zone Timer

desktopTools.label: Player Pictures

pipeline.title: One signal chain, run live for every match
pipeline.description: Every graphic on screen starts as raw match data. ScoreSync pulls that data the moment it's generated, turns it into broadcast-ready visuals and pushes it to the stream, with no manual entry and no delay.

steps.title: Ingest
steps.desc: Match data is pulled from the game and the tournament bracket the moment a round starts: kills, damage, circle phase, team standings.

steps.title: Render
steps.desc: Raw data is mapped onto the tournament's overlay theme in real time: live stats, kill feed, battle bar and rankings.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.desc: The finished overlay reaches the broadcast through the HUD control panel, where a producer switches views, themes and observer POVs live.

overlays.title: Broadcast overlay modules
overlays.description: Each module runs on its own or together with the others. Mix and match per tournament, per theme, per broadcast.
